purpose: Measure the Pixel 8a-calibrated shared 64-visit configuration against current v2 without tuning either player.

v3.backend: dedicated WebGPU in real browser Worker

common.opening: Random legal moves, shared between a colour-swapped pair; same per-ply seeds as the previous 300ms evaluation.
common.cappedGames: Report separately; do not replace with wins, draws or losses.

execution.stopRule: Complete 96 declared games regardless of results; no tuning, model selection or promotion.
execution.concurrency: One browser study at a time, no concurrent compute jobs.
execution.source: Pin hashes and snapshot the exact measured source and model before execution; fail if the inputs change.
execution.python: Use uv if Python is needed.

interpretation: Measures 64-visit application v3 against v2 depth 4. This is not equal compute time, a human rank estimate, or a head-to-head comparison with the older 300ms v3. Historical 300ms results are context only.
